title: The host can report a token budget as not yet applied while the budget is already stopping the sandbox
foundBy: code review of the token budget, reproduced by session agent
details:
A sandbox's reading of its token count applies the budget in the lender's memory and does not write that to the usage record. `cs-sandbox usage`, `inspect` and `ls` decide whether a budget is applied from that record alone.

A soft output limit lowered below what was already used made the reading report output as spent, which stops the turn driver. The record still held no applied budget, so `usage` kept printing `not yet applied`, with no next call coming to clear it. A sandbox with no calls yet had no record at all. Enforcement is not affected, but the report tells the operator the budget is not in force when it is.
